unit.name: Manual error analysis for AI pipelines
unit.description: This final unit shows how to inspect intermediate outputs across many bad queries, log component-level failures in a spreadsheet, and use hotspot counts to decide where engineering effort will matter most.
unit.summary: For the deep-research pipeline, the instructor enumerates several plausible failure points: weak search terms, stale or low-quality web search results, bad URL selection, or poor final writing [ts=3882s] [ts=3978s]. The remedy is explicit manual error analysis: run 10 to 100 problematic queries, inspect intermediate outputs stage by stage, and record judgments in a spreadsheet rather than guessing about bottlenecks [ts=4024s] [ts=4200s]. By tallying which columns fail most often, the team can see whether dissatisfaction is dominated by retrieval, fetching, or synthesis and then focus on the real hotspot [ts=4313s] [ts=4386s]. The payoff is strategic: a few hours of analysis can prevent weeks or months of optimization on the wrong subsystem [ts=4423s] [ts=4469s].

key_points.text: Pipeline failures can originate in query generation, search, fetch selection, or final writing.
Inspect intermediate outputs on a sample of bad queries instead of guessing where the bottleneck is.
A spreadsheet that marks failure modes per stage helps reveal which component is the true hotspot.
Hours spent on disciplined error analysis can save weeks of misdirected engineering work.

kp_catalog.name: Manual error analysis to locate system bottlenecks
kp_catalog.description: A disciplined process of inspecting failing examples stage by stage and quantifying which subsystem accounts for most user-visible errors.
kp_catalog.importance_rationale: Manual error analysis is the lecture’s main reusable decision procedure for AI project strategy.

kp_catalog.name: Pipeline decomposition for AI systems
kp_catalog.description: Representing an AI product as sequential components whose intermediate outputs can be inspected and improved independently.
kp_catalog.importance_rationale: Pipeline decomposition supports bottleneck diagnosis and error analysis.

kp_catalog.name: Iteration speed as a core AI project lever
kp_catalog.description: The idea that faster experiment-selection and execution loops matter more than small local modeling choices because they compound over time.
kp_catalog.importance_rationale: Iteration speed frames the project-strategy mindset but is not a technical prerequisite gate.
